features.title: Private agents and chats, and sharing with your project
features.body:
New chats and agents that you create in Agenta now start private. Only you see them until you share them. You can share a chat with chosen people as **Can view** or **Can send**, or make it visible to the whole project. You can also make an agent private.

Chats and agents that existed before this release keep working as before. They are visible to the project, with their creator as owner.

improvements.text: Claude Haiku 5.5 is available for agents, also on Pi
Built-in Gemini models use Google's native protocol

fixes.text: Stop keeps the partial answer and ends the turn as stopped
A message that you send stays when you switch to another chat
You can write to channel chats in the app, and private agents stay connected to their channels
A turn that reaches its time limit keeps the work it did
Long turns are no longer cut short by the output budget

features.title: Projects use only their own provider keys
features.body:
Prompts and evaluators now run on the provider keys saved in the project. A project without a key for a provider gets the error "No API key found for model". Add the key in **Settings > Providers & Models**.

Custom providers need their own API key, except Bedrock, SageMaker and Vertex. Self-hosted Enterprise deployments can opt in to keys set on the services container.

improvements.text: Built-in Gemini uses gemini-3.8-flash with low thinking by default

fixes.text: Built-in Gemini turns no longer hang when a Vertex call stalls
Gmail addresses with dots or a +tag count as one address at sign-up

features.title: Project access, permissions and runs that act as their creator
features.body:
Agenta now decides project access in one place. Creating, renaming and deleting a project follows organization roles. An API key acts only in its own project for management actions. When you remove a member or delete a key, the change takes effect at the next request.

Automations, evaluations and approvals run as the user or key that created them. If that identity loses access, the run stops and tells you why.

improvements.text: Agenta checks organization admin rights, SSO domains, credentials and password resets more strictly

fixes.text: The membership repair migration stays fast on large databases

features.title: Office file previews, preview comments and a redesigned chat
features.body:
The Files pane now previews Excel, Word and PowerPoint files, so you can open what your agent produces without leaving Agenta. You can also comment on a spot in an HTML app, document, slide or spreadsheet, and the agent receives the comment with its location.

Every file and folder in a session now has a link you can share. The chat transcript, file cards, attachments and composer have a new design. Agents open straight into the playground.

improvements.text: Opening an agent opens the playground, not the overview

fixes.text: Claude 5 models return JSON that matches your schema
Kimi K3.1 Pro agent turns no longer fail with a provider error
Stopping a run while its sandbox starts ends the run as cancelled
The trace drawer no longer swaps spans while you read them
One invalid MCP endpoint no longer hides the valid ones

features.title: Built-in models now serve only agent runs
features.body:
The built-in models that Agenta provides now serve only the agent runs that the platform starts. A direct call to the built-in model route with an API key, or with a credential exchanged from one, gets a `403` with the code `builtin_requires_agent_run`.

Calls with your own provider keys and connections work as before.

improvements.text: Code evaluators receive a scoped credential and no write-only provider keys
On Daytona, the gateway token stays out of the sandbox environment

fixes.text: The first run of a new agent that uses a stored Claude or ChatGPT sign-in no longer fails
Pi's ChatGPT subscription no longer offers models that ChatGPT refuses

features.title: Credit-based plans and reliability fixes
features.body: Agenta Cloud plans now use credits. The Pro plan is renamed Starter, every public plan gets 75 free credits a day (on up to 10 days a month), and new organizations start on Hobby with a 500-credit signup bonus. Version 0.122.5 also fixes analytics errors, live reply streaming in other projects, and Gemini on Vertex AI. Self-hosters should read the upgrade notes below.

features.title: See what your agents cost and how often they fail
features.body:
Settings now has an **Analytics** tab. It shows what your agents cost, how often they run, how often they succeed and how many tokens they use, over the last day, week, month or 90 days.

Group the charts by agent or by model to see where the money goes and which agents fail most. Click **Explore** to see the runs behind a number and open their traces.

features.title: A cleaner Settings, a What's New window, and live chat
features.body:
Settings is rebuilt on one layout. AI providers, integrations and channels are now catalogs you connect with a click, and every page works on a phone. You can also switch, create and transfer organizations, and remove members.

New releases now show up in a **What's New** window with a short video. Empty pages explain what they're for and suggest templates to start from. And on Agenta Cloud, you can reach our team from the live chat button in the sidebar.

features.title: Agent runs that hold up
features.body:
Agent runs hold up better. When a model stalls before it starts answering, Agenta retries the turn on its own instead of failing your message. Long runs keep their connection and their full trace.

The queue also responds the moment you click, and while an agent starts up, you can see what it's doing.

features.title: Expand the files pane
features.body: You can now expand the files pane to fill the window while you read or edit a file. Click again to get your chat and layout back.

features.title: Browse the Agent Marketplace
features.body:
The Templates page is now the **Agent Marketplace**. See templates at work in example runs, filter them by category or by the apps you already use, and preview one without leaving the list.

Each template has its own page with an example run, how it works, the tools it uses and how to set it up. Click **Use this template** to start.

features.title: Reply to one part of an agent's answer
features.body:
Select any part of an agent's reply, or a few lines in a file, and reply to just that part. The agent sees the exact text you mean, so you don't have to describe "the second bullet about pricing".

You can also collect quotes from several replies and files and send them in one message.

features.title: Send files and voice notes to your agent in Slack, Telegram and WhatsApp
features.body: You can now send photos, documents, voice notes and videos to your agent in Slack, Telegram and WhatsApp. They reach the agent as attachments, so you can hand it a screenshot or a quick voice note from the chat app you already use.
